reviews.comment: Professor Williamson is one of the professors who genuinely cares about what he is teaching. His lectures are always interesting, he provides great feedback on essays, the work load is very manageable, and a lot of it is group work. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good Professor just some things make him annoying at times. For example, it's nearly impossible to reach him outside of class so if you are sick or have to miss class for some reason good luck getting a response to your email any time soon. If you want advice or help you need to talk to him in class in person.

Teaching style: Amazing. Super nice guy and I felt like I learned a lot about what we covered. Did a lot of group work in class so you never really had homework outside of readings. Content: AWFUL. I was so uncomfortable most of the class. Topics: Homosexuality (a lot), Assault of minors, sexuality of minors, infidelity, suicide, domestic violence.

II struggle with English but he did an amazing job teaching.He even said in the beginning of the year that he understands that there are nonenglish majors so he just wants to help you succeed. So helpful in giving corrections during office hours, and was so understanding if you're struggling and need help.
